description: This source file defines a set of API helper functions for frontend communication with a backend REST API, including methods for GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests, as well as specific functions for managing work items and comments in a project management context.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if the provided API path is public (no auth required), specifically allows login and signup endpoints.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds request headers, adding Authorization header if the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles non-OK HTTP responses, including auto-logout on 401 errors for protected routes.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request with automatic auth handling.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON payload and automatic auth handling.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request with optional query parameters and automatic auth handling.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with JSON payload and automatic auth handling.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific work item, sourcing author id from local storage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, including creator info from local storage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds and returns the full URL for a given API endpoint.
